debate-night-champion.name: Debate Night - Champion
debate-night-champion.description: Awarded to members of the team that won the overall Debate Night event.
debate-night-champion.criteria: Awarded to the participants who demonstrated the strongest overall argumentation, reasoning, and debating performance.

debate-night-individual-winner.name: Debate Night - Individual Debate Winner
debate-night-individual-winner.description: Awarded to the highest-scoring speaker in the individual debate round at Debate Night.
debate-night-individual-winner.criteria: Delivered the strongest individual argument in the timed speech round as evaluated by the judging panel.

debate-night-judge.name: Debate Night - Judge
debate-night-judge.description: Awarded to individuals who served as judges during Debate Night.
debate-night-judge.criteria: Evaluated debates, scored arguments, and contributed to determining the event results.

debate-night-participant.name: Debate Night - Participant
debate-night-participant.description: Awarded to participants who took part in Debate Night.
debate-night-participant.criteria: Actively participated in the individual or team debate rounds during the event.

hackathon-winning-team.name: Cyber Security Society Hackathon - Winning Team Member
hackathon-winning-team.description: Given to students in the first-place team at an official Cybersoc hackathon.
hackathon-winning-team.criteria: Placed first in a Cybersoc-run hackathon event.

hackathon-participant.name: Cyber Security Society Hackathon - Participant
hackathon-participant.description: Awarded to participants of an official Cybersoc hackathon.
hackathon-participant.criteria: Participated in a Cybersoc-run hackathon event.

mini-hackathon-winning-team.name: Cyber Security Society Mini-Hackathon - Winning Team Member
mini-hackathon-winning-team.description: Given to students in the first-place team at an official Cybersoc mini-hackathon.
mini-hackathon-winning-team.criteria: Placed first in a Cybersoc-run mini-hackathon event.

mini-hackathon-participant.name: Cyber Security Society Mini-Hackathon - Participant
mini-hackathon-participant.description: Awarded to participants of an official Cybersoc mini-hackathon.
mini-hackathon-participant.criteria: Participated in a Cybersoc-run mini-hackathon event.
